episodes.title: On Evangelizing Hindus (Ep. 76)
episodes.description: How do you share the gospel with a Hindu neighbor? In this episode, Ryan Robertson, Kyle Brousseau, and J.P. Stokes discuss Hindu beliefs, common misconceptions, and practical ways Christians can faithfully engage Hindus with the good news of Jesus Christ. Guests: Kyle Brousseau & JP Stokes

episodes.title: On Translation to Indigenous Publishing (Ep. 75)
episodes.description: How does faithful publishing strengthen global missions? In this episode, we explore how translation, indigenous authorship, and theological resources help build healthy churches around the world. Guests: Rick Denham & David Adams

episodes.title: On Evangelizing Muslims (Ep. 74)
episodes.description: How should Christians think about evangelism among Muslims? This episode explores faithful gospel witness, contextualization, discipleship, and the hope of Christ in hard places.

episodes.title: On The Path To Being A Missionary (Ep. 73)
episodes.description: A new generation of missionaries doesn’t appear overnight. Ryan Robertson and Matt Bennett discuss their new book, The Path to Being a Missionary, and unpack how churches can identify, assess, prepare, and send faithful missionaries.

episodes.title: On John Paton (Ep. 72)
episodes.description: Who was John Paton, and why is he considered one of the greatest missionaries in church history? In this episode, Paul Schlehlein explores Paton’s life, theology, suffering, and enduring legacy as a missionary to the New Hebrides.

episodes.title: On Culture & Language Acquisition in Tokyo (Ep. 71)
episodes.description: What does it actually take for missionaries to learn a new language and culture? In this episode, missionaries serving in Japan share the challenges, lessons, and practical realities of language acquisition and cultural adaptation on the mission field. Guests: Stephen Tipton & Robbie Hughes

episodes.title: On Global Cities Partnership (Ep. 70)
episodes.description: What is the Global Cities Partnership, and why does it matter for missions today? In this episode, we explore the vision behind this strategic effort to strengthen healthy churches and gospel infrastructure in the world’s most influential cities.

episodes.title: On Risk Assessment in the Mission Field (Ep. 69)
episodes.description: How should missionaries, churches, and sending agencies think about danger on the mission field? In this episode, Caleb Greggsen joins the conversation to explore risk, suffering, resurrection hope, and what it means to count the cost of obedience in global missions.

episodes.title: On Preparing & Planning for Tokyo (Ep. 68)
episodes.description: In this episode of Missions Talk, Ryan Robertson talks with David King, David Rainer, and Mindy Rainer about God’s providential leading of Concord Baptist Church to send the Rainers to Tokyo to plant a church.

episodes.title: On Reading The Bible Evangelistically (Ep. 67)
episodes.description: This episode with Isaac Stiles & Ethan English explores how evangelistic Bible studies can be a powerful, church-centered tool for reaching unbelievers, especially on college campuses. Resources Mentioned One-to-One Bible Reading by David Helm Christianity Explained by Mark Dever

episodes.title: On The Great Commission Congress (Ep. 66)
episodes.description: Ryan Robertson, Mack Stiles, Josh Manley, and Danny Davison discuss the vision behind the Great Commission Council and the upcoming Great Commission Congress, highlighting a shared call for theologically grounded, church-centered missions. Resources Mentioned: Great Commission Council Bangkok Congress ‘26

episodes.title: On Elenctics (Ep. 65)
episodes.description: Mack and Ryan discuss elenctics and its missiological importance in this discussion with Daniel Strange and Ben Robin, highlighting the work of J.H. Bavinck.

episodes.title: On Prioritizing the Church in Missions (Ep. 64)
episodes.description: Join Ryan Robertson, Mack Stiles, John Folmar, and Scott Logsdon as they explore the importance of prioritizing the church in missions, highlighting how a strong ecclesiological foundation can transform missionary work and foster long-term impact across cultures.

episodes.title: On Ministry in Kuala Lumpur (Ep. 63)
episodes.description: Ryan talks with missionaries about life and ministry in KL. Resources Mentioned The Joshua Project - Unreached People Groups

episodes.title: On Hermeneutics & Missions (Ep. 62)
episodes.description: Join Ryan Robertson, Mack Stiles, Brian Parks, and Aubrey Sequeira as they explore the intersection of hermeneutics and missions, discussing how proper biblical interpretation can safeguard against the misapplication of scripture in cross-cultural contexts.

episodes.title: On Healthy Resources in Malaysia (Ep. 61)
episodes.description: Ryan talks with Massimo about the need for solid resources and healthy churches in Malaysia. Resources Mentioned Biblical Theology by Nick Roark and Robert Cline Compelling Community by Mark Dever and Jamie Dunlop How to Build a Healthy Church by Mark Dever and Paul Alexander The Gospel by Ray Ortlund Habits of Grace by David Mathis Seeing and Savoring Jesus Christ by John Piper The Gospel at Work

episodes.title: On Setting Strategic Priorities for Missions Sending from your Local Church (Ep. 60)
episodes.description: Mack and Ryan discuss how local churches consider strategic missions priorities with Robert Cline and Jeffrey Timmons.

episodes.title: On God's Sovereignty and Missions (Ep. 59)
episodes.description: What is the relation between God's Sovereignty and our role in Missions? Ryan and Mack talk to AJ Gibson about this important theological understanding and what the Bible teaches. Resources Mentioned: Evangelism and the Sovereignty of God by J.I. episodes.title: On Prioritizing Missions in the Church (Ep. 58)
episodes.description: In this live episode from RTIM's Sending Church Summit, Ryan and Mack discuss the new volume, Prioritizing Missions in the Church, with its authors, Aaron Menikoff & Harshit Singh. Resources Mentioned: Prioritizing Missions in the Church by Aaron Menikoff and Harshit Singh

episodes.title: On Preparation for the Missions Field (Ep. 57)
episodes.description: In this episode, Ryan, Mac, Matt, & Hunter discuss what aspiring missionaries and their local churches should consider when preparing for overseas ministry.

episodes.title: On Church-Centered Missions (Ep. 56)
episodes.description: In this season opening of Missions Talk, Ryan and Mack talk with Jonathan Leeman about Church Centered Missions—highlighting how healthy local churches with a strong ecclesiology are vital for training missionaries, shaping strategy, and planting churches. Learn more about Church Centered Missions here: https://www.churchcenteredmissions.org

episodes.title: On Healthy Indigenous Churches (Ep. 55)
episodes.description: In this episode of Missions Talk, Ryan, Mack, and TJ explore the marks of a healthy indigenous church, highlighting key practices like regular gatherings and faithful preaching, while addressing the challenges missionaries face in establishing churches that are both biblically sound and culturally rooted.

episodes.title: On Contextualization and the Bible (Ep. 54)
episodes.description: Ryan and Mack talk with Elliot Clark and Caleb Greggsen about the complexities of contextualization in missions—how to faithfully communicate the gospel across cultures with clarity, humility, and cultural sensitivity. Resources Mentioned Evangelism as Exiles by Elliot Clark Mission Affirmed by Elliot Clark The Culture Map by Erin Meyer

episodes.title: On Missions Work in Bangkok, with Matt Tyler and Danny Davison (Ep. 53)
episodes.description: Ryan and Mack talk with Matt Tyler and Danny Davison about missions work in Bangkok, the need for healthy churches, and gospel opportunities in Thailand. Resources Mentioned Bangkok City Baptist Church Systematic Theology, Vol. 1 by Stephen J. Wellum Great Commission Council (GCC) Articles

episodes.title: On Missions in Uganda, with Tony Gordon and Kris Mobbs (Ep. 52)
episodes.description: In this episode, Ryan & Mack speak with two missionaries serving in Uganda about ministry there and the state of the church in the country.

episodes.title: Isaiah 43: On Blind and Deaf Witnesses to God's Glorious Salvation (Ep. 190)
episodes.description: What does it mean that the Lord saves his people "for his own sake"? How can we trust him? How can we know that he loves us? Isaiah 43 raises some soul-stirring questions. In this episode of Bible Talk, Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss.

episodes.title: From Silence to Sinai: Another Special Episode of Bible Talk (Ep. 189)
episodes.description: In this episode of Bible Talk, Jim and Sam chat with Alex about his new book From Silence to Sinai: A Guided Tour of Exodus. They laugh a lot—sometimes at Alex, sometimes with him.

episodes.title: A Special Episode about Jim's Transparent Translation of the Psalms (Ep. 188)
episodes.description: In this special episode of Bible Talk, Alex and Sam talk with Jim about his new "transparent" translation of the Psalms.

episodes.title: Isaiah 42: On the Spirit-Filled Servant Who Calls the World to Sing (Ep. 187)
episodes.description: In this passage, Isaiah starts to describe a "servant" who has a mission for the nations. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss Isaiah 42.

episodes.title: Isaiah 41: On Jonathan Edwards Predicting the Presidency of Donald Trump (Ep. 186)
episodes.description: In Isaiah 41, the Lord puts the gods of other nations on trial—and then he demolishes their case. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss.

episodes.title: Isaiah 40: On the Dwindling Window of Youth and the Everlasting Comfort of God (Ep. 185)
episodes.description: Isaiah 40 is a glorious passage. Alex, Jim, and Sam do their best.

episodes.title: Isaiah 38–39: On the Complex Conclusion of King Hezekiah (Ep. 184)
episodes.description: What should we make of Hezekiah's final act—his sickness, his recovery, his seemingly self-centered prayer at the end? That question may be tougher to answer than you think. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss Isaiah 38–39.

episodes.title: Isaiah 37: On the Passage that Should Make You Google the Lachish Reliefs (Ep. 183)
episodes.description: In this episode of Bible Talk, Alex chats with Jim and Sam about Hezekiah's faith, God's commitment to himself, and Sennacherib's ironic downfall.

episodes.title: Isaiah 36: On Trusting the Lord and Rebelling Against the World (Ep. 182)
episodes.description: Bible Talk is back! Our march through Isaiah continues as we enter a new section, in which Assyria's hype-man taunts Israel and tempts them to leave their God. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss Isaiah 36.

episodes.title: Isaiah 35: On What the World Will Be Like When Sin and Suffering Cease (Ep. 181)
episodes.description: The last episode before summer break ends on a high note. If Isaiah 34 depicts a world overrun by the sin's curse, then Isaiah 35 depicts a world overrun by salvation's joy. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss.

episodes.title: Isaiah 34: On What the World Would Be Like if God Left Us Alone (Ep. 180)
episodes.description: Have you ever wondered what the world would be like if God left us alone after Genesis 3? That's kind of what Isaiah 34 is like. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss.

episodes.title: Isaiah 33: On Governments of Angels and Streams of Structureless Consciousness (Ep. 179)
episodes.description: This episode touches on a lot: the founding of America and its separation of powers, whether Isaiah writes like William Faulkner, and how the world will end. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss Isaiah 33.

episodes.title: Isaiah 31–32: On the Meaningful Difference between Jim's "Very Good" and "You're Exactly Right" (Ep. 178)
episodes.description: In Isaiah 31–32, we get a great example of the "dual lenses" through which Isaiah sees God's work in the future. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss.

episodes.title: Isaiah 30: On High-School Bible Studies & Forks in the Road (Ep. 177)
episodes.description: Isaiah 30 offers glimpses of both Israel's near future and eternal future. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss this fascinating passage.

episodes.title: Isaiah 29: On Divine Deliverance from A to Z, From Ariel to Zion (Ep. 176)
episodes.description: Isaiah 29 offers a play-by-play of what we see in the Gospels—from the miraculous to the call to the meek and the poor. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss.

episodes.title: Isaiah 28: On Judgment and Gibberish (Ep. 175)
episodes.description: We're covering similar terrain in Isaiah 28, which raises an important question: What do you do when you come across seemingly repetitive segments of Scripture? Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss.

episodes.title: Isaiah 27: On the Blood of the Leviathan and the Fruit of Forgiveness (Ep. 174)
episodes.description: This passage has everything: dying dragons, a world covered in the fruit of forgiveness, and a surprising trumpet blast. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss Isaiah 27.

episodes.title: Isaiah 26: On A Bunch of Load-Bearing, Poetic Metaphors that Point to Being Born Again, Again (Ep. 173)
episodes.description: In this episode of Bible Talk, Alex chats with Jim and Sam about Isaiah 26, a dense, metaphor-laden passage that cranes its neck to the glorious future that awaits all those who trust in the LORD.

episodes.title: Isaiah 25–26: On God Swallowing Up Death Forever (Ep. 172)
episodes.description: The judgment of the whole earth (Isaiah 24) gives way to the hope of the whole earth: a God-initiated resurrection. In this episode of Bible Talk, Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss Isaiah 25–26.

episodes.title: Isaiah 24: On the Escalating, Eschatological, All-Encompassing End of Everything (Ep. 171)
episodes.description: In this passage, the scope widens as the destruction of particular nations gives way to the destruction of the world. Alex, Jim, and Sam talk about Isaiah 24.

episodes.title: 1 Peter 5:1-5: On Job Descriptions and Dispositions (A Bonus Episode)
episodes.description: In this bonus episode of Bible Talk, Alex chats with Jim and Sam about 1 Peter 5:1–5. They focus on a pastor's job description and disposition. Who knew these guys talked about the New Testament, too!?

episodes.title: Isaiah 23: On Bitcoin's Nadir and the Inevitable Futility of Living for Money (Ep. 170)
episodes.description: In this episode of Bible Talk, Alex chats with Jim and Sam about the oracle against Tyre in Isaiah 23. This passage teaches us, among other things, why it's stupid to put our hope in money.

episodes.title: Isaiah 22: On the Valley of Vision—Not the Devotional, but the Destruction (Ep. 169)
episodes.description: After several chapters of judgment against the nations, the scope of God's judgment now zeroes in on Judah. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss Isaiah 22.

episodes.title: Isaiah 21: On the Judgment Against Babylon and a Truman Capote Conspiracy Theory (Ep. 168)
episodes.description: This episode of Bible Talk walks through Isaiah 21, which features an enigmatic, yet grand prophecy on the coming judgment of Babylon. Watch as Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss.

episodes.title: Isaiah 19–20: On the Egyptian Exodus and the Glorious Task of Global Missions (Ep. 167)
episodes.description: One of the clearest motivators for global missions can be found, believe it or not, right here amidst oracles of judgment against disobedient nations. This passage is glorious. Alex, Jim, and Sam discuss Isaiah 19–20.

episodes.title: On A Heart Aflame for God (Ep. 346)
episodes.description: In this episode of Pastors Talk, Jonathan and Mark are joined by Ben Lacey and Dr. Matthew Bingham to discuss Bingham’s new book A Heart Aflame for God: A Reformed Approach to Spiritual Formation. Together they survey some of the popular approaches to spiritual formation shaping evangelicals today and show why each tends to sideline regeneration and the sufficiency of God’s Word.

episodes.title: On Using Authority Well (Ep. 345)
episodes.description: In this episode of Pastors Talk, Alex Duke fills in for Mark Dever to talk with Jonathan Leeman about his book, Using Authority Well: A Concise Guide for Men. Jonathan makes the case that authority is not a necessary evil but a gift from God; one meant to create and build up life, as pictured in 2 Samuel 23 and Psalm 72, rather than to exploit or destroy.

episodes.title: On Redemption Song (Ep. 344)
episodes.description: In this episode of Pastors Talk, Mark Dever sits down with Sean DeMars to talk about his book Redemption Song, a short and approachable primer on congregational singing. Using Moses' song in Exodus 15 as a lens, they explore why God's people sing, how the regulative principle guides our worship (and why it needn't be scary or restrictive), and why singing is part of the word ministry of the church

episodes.title: On The Path to Being a Missionary (Ep. 343)
episodes.description: In this episode of Pastors Talk, Jonathan talks with Ryan Robertson about his new book (co-authored with Matt Bennett), The Path to Being a Missionary. Together they unpack why "I'm called" is better understood as aspiration tested by a local church, and why Ryan so often tells eager candidates to wait.

episodes.title: On Being a Pastor's Wife (Ep. 342)
episodes.description: In this episode of Pastors Talk, Jonathan talks to Mark and Connie Dever, a candid vulnerable conversation about being a pastor's wife.

episodes.title: On Hymn Writing with Matt Boswell (Ep. 341)
episodes.description: In this special live episode of Pastors Talk, Jonathan Leeman sits down with hymn writer, worship professor, and pastor Matt Boswell to talk about the craft and calling of writing hymns for the church. episodes.title: On Ministry in Kurdistan (Ep. 340)
episodes.description: In this episode of Pastors Talk, Jonathan Leeman and Mark Dever are joined by David Lawrence, pastor of Erbil Baptist Church, and Jeremy Barker of the Mustard Seed Foundation, to discuss gospel work in Kurdistan — the semi-autonomous Kurdish region of northern Iraq.

episodes.title: On Let the Word Dwell Richly (Ep. 339)
episodes.description: In this episode of Pastors Talk, Caleb Morell and Mark Dever sit down with Australian author Tony Payne (co-author of The Trellis and the Vine ) to discuss his new book, Let the Word Dwell Richly. episodes.title: On the Pleasures of God with John Piper (Ep. 338)
episodes.description: In this special episode of Pastors Talk, Jonathan Leeman and Mark Dever welcome John Piper to reflect on his book The Pleasures of God, newly reissued by Crossway. episodes.title: Special Episode: On Preaching About the American Revolution (Ep. 337)
episodes.description: In this episode of Pastors Talk, Jonathan Leeman and Mark Dever discuss the unusual sermon Mark preached on July 5th, 2026 — the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence; tackling the question, "Are we celebrating the 250th anniversary of a sin?" episodes.description: In this special episode of Pastors Talk, Jonathan Leeman sits down with Mark and Connie Dever to talk through Mark's sudden medical event. episodes.title: On Raising Up Leaders Part 4 (Ep. 335)
episodes.description: In the season finale of Pastors Talk, Jonathan Leeman is joined by Ligon Duncan and Michael Lawrence to discuss the state of the pastoral pipeline — examining why fewer men are entering ministry, the role of demographics and seminary debt, and what healthy churches and seminaries can do about it.

episodes.title: On Raising Up Leaders Part 3 (Ep. 334)
episodes.description: In part three of their series on raising up leaders, Jonathan Leeman and Mark Dever work through nine practical principles Mark uses to identify and develop future pastors — from spotting qualified men and extending trust early, to delegating well, cultivating feedback loops, embracing a healthy view of authority, and modeling clarity and humility. episodes.title: On Raising Up Leaders Part 2 (Ep. 333)
episodes.description: Jonathan Leeman and Mark Dever continue their conversation on raising up leaders, exploring the connection between discipleship, evangelism, and church planting, how to measure ministry fruitfulness beyond numbers, and what it means to steward your church for the next pastor.

episodes.title: On Raising Up Leaders Part 1 (Ep. 332)
episodes.description: In this episode of Pastors Talk, Jonathan and Mark dive into the essential, yet often challenging, practice of raising up leaders and passing out authority. They discuss what it takes to build a ministry around giving authority away rather than consolidating it.

episodes.title: On Drifting from the Gospel (Ep. 331)
episodes.description: Hebrews 2:1 warns believers to pay close attention to the gospel message to avoid drifting away from their faith. Mark and Jonathan talk to Jared Wilson about his book on this topic and how believers should be thinking carefully about the centrality of the gospel in their lives.

episodes.title: On "Can I Reimburse that as a Pastor?" (Ep. 330)
episodes.description: How should pastors think about their work hours? What are some principles that churches and pastors can consider for pastors to get reimbursed? Mark and Jonathan talk with Garrett and Mike on lessons learned.

episodes.title: On Discerning Repentance in Church Discipline (Ep. 329)
episodes.description: Should Christians talk about discerning the repentance of other Christians? What are the instructions from the New Testament to churches? Mark and Jonathan invite Caleb Morell to discuss this.

episodes.title: On The Homebound and Those Near Death (Ep. 328)
episodes.description: How to pastor and walk with those in the unique season of life when they can't leave home and approaching death. Mark and Jonathan discuss practical ideas on how to be mindful as pastors.

episodes.title: On Eastern Orthodoxy Part 2 (Ep. 327)
episodes.description: Jonathan and Mark Feather talk to Joshua Schooping, a former Eastern Orthodox priest, on how to pastor church members who may be considering joining the Eastern Orthodox church.

episodes.title: On Eastern Orthodoxy Part 1 (Ep. 326)
episodes.description: Jonathan, Mark and Mark Feather talk to Joshua Schooping, a former Eastern Orthodox priest, on the reasons he had to leave that church.

episodes.title: On The Ministry of Small Things and Fighting Pastoral Cynicism (Ep. 325)
episodes.description: Jonathan talks to Reuben Bredenhof, author of The Ministry of Small Things. They consider the ordinary ministry of pastors, focusing on all the small things they must be faithful to, and reflect on the temptation of pastoral cynicism.

episodes.title: On Why Should Pastors Teach the Job Description of Deacons (Ep. 324)
episodes.description: If Jesus is the great deacon, what does that say about the office of deacon in our churches? Jonathan sits down with Larry Lazarus to discuss why it is important for churches to know the job descriptions of deacons.

episodes.title: On Why Should Pastors Teach Their Job Descriptions (Ep. 323)
episodes.description: Have you ever wondered why it's important for congregations to know their pastor's job description according to the Bible? Jonathan sits down with his senior pastor, Larry Lazarus, to consider this question.

episodes.description: Mark talks to H.B. Charles Jr. on ministerial calling and how he prepares for preaching.

episodes.title: On Specific Audiences (Ep. 106)
episodes.description: How is preaching to a very specific audience (youth group, prisoners, etc.) differ from a Sunday morning? How does one preach well in these settings? Dave, Ed, and Jeremy speak from personal experience to help the preacher do the best they can.

episodes.title: On One-Off Sermons (Ep. 105)
episodes.description: When should a pastor break into a series to do a one-off sermon? What kinds of things need to be kept in mind to help determine if it should be done? What does one need to keep in mind when doing a one-off sermon? Listen in as Ed, Dave, and Jeremy discuss.

episodes.title: On Preacher's Mailbag #9 (Ep. 104)
episodes.description: Jeremy dives into the mailbag once again to ask listener submitted questions to Ed and Dave.

episodes.title: On the Tone of the Text (Ep. 103)
episodes.description: What should the preacher do with the tone of the text? How does the distinction in the audience affect the sermon? Dave, Ed, and Jeremy discuss this important topic.

episodes.title: On Learning to Preach the Bible from the Bible #1 (Ep. 102)
episodes.description: Dave, Ed, and Jeremy begin an occasional series sharing things they are learning about preaching the Bible from the Bible itself.

episodes.title: On Humility in Preaching (Ep. 101)
episodes.description: Why is humility important in preaching? How does a preacher cultivate humility? Why do some texts demand more humility than others? Listen in as Ed, Dave, and Jeremy discuss.

episodes.title: On 25 years of the Simeon Trust (Ep. 100)
episodes.description: Where did the Simeon Trust come from? Why does it exist? Where is it headed? Listen in as Dave, Ed, and Jeremy reminisce and thank God together for what he has done. We’ll select one person to receive a bundle of preaching resources from 9Marks and Simeon Trust.

episodes.title: On Using Analogies As Illustrations (Ep. 99)
episodes.description: Using illustrations is often challenging or overly alluring for the preacher. How can analogies help the preacher use compact and powerful illustrations? How does the Bible use analogies? Listen in as Dave and Jeremy are joined by Kevin Walker.

episodes.title: On Secondary Resources in Preaching (Ep. 98)
episodes.description: The Bible is a fascinating, ancient document. What is the utility of secondary literature to understand the text? How can the preacher best utilize it in preaching? Dave and Jeremy sit down with Scott Hafemann to discuss.

episodes.title: On Preaching for Repentance (Ep. 97)
episodes.description: Preachers need to be aimed at far more than information distribution. How does one preach with the goal of repentance? Dave, Ed, and Jeremy wrestle with the challenge.

episodes.title: On Preaching Broadly (Ep. 96)
episodes.description: How does a preacher speak to the whole audience in ways that go deep without losing people and broad without being boring? Ed, Dave, and Jeremy give some insights.

episodes.title: On Using Your Voice (Ep. 95)
episodes.description: It can be a challenge to know how to speak naturally in the pulpit. How can a preacher grow in the maintenance and use of their voice? Dave, Ed, and Jeremy talk from personal experience.

episodes.title: Preachers Mailbag #8 (Ep. 94)
episodes.description: Jeremy dives back into the mailbag to ask listener questions to Ed and Dave about preaching.

episodes.title: On Humor in Preaching (Ep. 93)
episodes.description: Is humor ever appropriate in preaching? If so, what are some principles to keep in mind as we utilize it? Hear Dave, Ed, and Jeremy, who have very different personalities, discuss.

episodes.title: On The Systematic Theology of the Father (Ep. 92)
episodes.description: How does the doctrine of God help in preaching texts? How do we say what we should without saying to little or too much in a sermon? Ed, Dave, and Jeremy discuss, providing examples from their own work.

episodes.title: On Simplicity (Ep. 91)
episodes.description: Why is simplicity in preaching important? Who benefits? How do we strive for it without being simplistic? Kevin Walker joins Ed and Jeremy to discuss.

episodes.title: On Creativity (Ep. 90)
episodes.description: Should a preacher seek to be creative? How might such an attempt go wrong? Ed, Dave, and Jeremy revel in the creativity of the Bible and what it has to teach us about our own use of creativity with words. episodes.title: On Using Systematic Theology in Preaching (Ep. 89)
episodes.description: How does one utilize systematic theology in exposition well? What are the benefits of attempting such a thing? Dave, Ed, and Jeremy begin a mini-series on the use of systematic theology in preaching.

episodes.title: On Topical Preaching (Ep. 88)
episodes.description: There seem to be moments that demand a topical sermon. What are they? How can a topical sermon be done well? Dave, Ed, and Jeremy discuss and provide examples.

episodes.title: On Preaching to the Heart (Ep. 87)
episodes.description: Engaging the emotions and the will can be tricky. Should we do such a thing in preaching? How do we do so well? Listen in as Ed, Dave, and Jeremy discuss. episodes.title: On Preaching Memorable Sermons (Ep. 86)
episodes.description: Every preacher has a sermon or two that sticks out in their mind from a fellow preacher. What makes a sermon memorable? How do we thread the needle between wanting to be memorable and legitimately helping our people remember what they were taught? Ed, Dave, and Jeremy try to figure it out.

episodes.title: On Precision in Application (Ep. 85)
episodes.description: It is easy to float away from the text and talk about the same things every week. We should apply sermons, but how? How do we do application without getting sidetracked? Dave, Ed, and Jeremy discuss.

episodes.title: On Training Preachers in Asia (Ep. 84)
episodes.description: What is going on in Asia these days when it comes to training preachers? What are the challenges and encouragements? Darrell Young, the Simeon Trust's man in Asia, joins Dave and Jeremy to discuss. Subscribe to our new podcast, A Storm in the Desert.

episodes.title: Preacher Mailbag #7 (Ep. 83)
episodes.description: How should pastors listen to preaching without getting distracted or overly critical? Should kids ever not be present in a sermon, given the content? episodes.title: On Short Bible Talks (Ep. 82)
episodes.description: Preachers often have opportunities to give short talks at events from the bible. What is the preacher to do in such situations? What are the challenges? And how can these talks improve our regular preaching? Ed, Dave, and Jeremy discuss.

episodes.title: A Storm In The Desert Trailer

Two decades later, John Folmar “accepted Jesus as his personal Savior”; he doesn’t know even where he first heard that phrase. What happens in the next quarter-century is a testament to God’s commitment to use faithful, ordinary ministry to effect fruitful, extraordinary change. A Storm in the Desert tells this story.
